title: Schwere Körperverletzung und versuchte räuberische Erpressung – Tatverdächtiger festgenommen

extraction.summaryEn: A 33-year-old man was stabbed in the neck at a bus stop in Neukölln in the early morning. A 36-year-old suspect later threatened a woman with a knife on a bus in Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg and demanded money; he was arrested.
